chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from Hajjaj, from Khalid ibn al-Hajjaj, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) who said:
"Do not eat the game if it falls into the water and dies."
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on eating game that dies after falling into water?
ai.summary: In *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Shaykh al-Tusi records this narration from Imam al-Rida (AS) to clarify the specific condition of death for game caught in water. This ruling distinguishes between animals that die immediately upon impact versus those that perish later, reflecting the Shia juristic emphasis on the manner of death for permissible consumption (halal).
